title: Error Handling
description: Learn how to display expected errors and handle uncaught exceptions.

title: Error Handling - Handling Expected Errors
text_content: Expected errors are those that can occur during the normal operation of the application, such as those from [/docs/app/building-your-application/data-fetching/server-actions-and-mutations#server-side-form-validation](/docs/app/building-your-application/data-fetching/server-actions-and-mutations#server-side-form-validation) or failed requests. These errors should be handled explicitly and returned to the client.
